free_tier.stated: the engine is open source and runs locally; the cloud runs the same pipelines, with no plan or price on this page

egress.terms: Cloud usage pricing bills pipeline outputs (pushed container images and container egress) at 10 cents per GB for new work and 2 cents per GB for repeat work; no free allowance is stated; plans are Starter USD 20 a month and Scale USD 200 a month, billed at the higher of plan price or usage
egress.price_per_tb: USD 100 per TB for new work, USD 20 per TB for repeat work

interface_detail: the dagger CLI, with modules and SDKs in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, PHP, Elixir and Rust; engine selectable as cloud, local container, tcp, tls, ssh or kube-pod; no SDK term in the interface vocabulary

limits.value: no plan or price is published; the local engine is free and the cloud path is priced elsewhere

confidence_note: the site was read on 2026-10-22 and describes a portable pipeline engine that a user can run locally or in the vendor's cloud. It publishes no plan or price, so the free half is the software rather than capacity

evidence.proved: 'Dagger is the missing software stack for CI. It makes your pipelines faster and more repeatable, not by throwing bigger machines at them, but by replacing artisanal scripts with a clean API' and 'run it locally or let our cloud scale it out', quoted
